description: This file contains Redux reducers and related functions for managing user-related state in the Mattermost application, including user profiles, sessions, statuses, group memberships, and other user metadata.

methods.name: profilesToSet
methods.description: Adds user profiles to a set relation for a team based on action data.

methods.name: removeProfilesFromSet
methods.description: Removes user profiles from a set relation for a team based on action data.

methods.name: profileListToSet
methods.description: Replaces or adds a list of user profiles to a set relation for a team.

methods.name: removeProfileListFromSet
methods.description: Removes a list of user profiles from a set relation for a team.

methods.name: addProfileToSet
methods.description: Adds a single user profile to a set relation.

methods.name: removeProfileFromSets
methods.description: Removes a user profile from all set relations.

methods.name: removeProfileFromSet
methods.description: Removes a single user profile from a specific set relation.

methods.name: currentUserId
methods.description: Reducer managing the current user's ID based on actions like login, logout, and receiving user data.

methods.name: mySessions
methods.description: Reducer managing the list of user sessions.

methods.name: myAudits
methods.description: Reducer managing the list of user audits.

methods.name: receiveUserProfile
methods.description: Merges received user profile data into the state, handling sensitive data and merging logic.

methods.name: profiles
methods.description: Reducer managing user profiles, including receiving, updating, and deleting profiles.

methods.name: profilesInTeam
methods.description: Reducer managing user profiles within teams.

methods.name: profilesNotInTeam
methods.description: Reducer managing user profiles not in specific teams.

methods.name: profilesInChannel
methods.description: Reducer managing user profiles within channels.

methods.name: profilesNotInChannel
methods.description: Reducer managing user profiles not in specific channels.

methods.name: profilesInGroup
methods.description: Reducer managing user profiles within groups.

methods.name: profilesNotInGroup
methods.description: Reducer managing user profiles not in specific groups.

methods.name: dndEndTimes
methods.description: Reducer managing Do Not Disturb end times for users.

methods.name: statuses
methods.description: Reducer managing user statuses.

methods.name: isManualStatus
methods.description: Reducer managing flags indicating if user statuses are manually set.

methods.name: myUserAccessTokens
methods.description: Reducer managing user access tokens.

methods.name: stats
methods.description: Reducer managing user statistics.

methods.name: filteredStats
methods.description: Reducer managing filtered user statistics.

methods.name: lastActivity
methods.description: Reducer managing last activity timestamps for users.
